name: Guy's and St Thomas' NHS Foundation Trust (Engineering team)
summary: London NHS foundation trust whose Engineering team hosted T Level Engineering students on a 45-day industry placement, working with the mechanical engineering team on maintenance jobs across the hospital estate.

name: British Airways
summary: Airline that has taken Kingston College T Level Design and Development for Engineering and Manufacturing students on industry placements.
keywords: aircraft maintenance;Heathrow;aerospace engineering;T Level Design and Development
how_to_apply: Engineering work experience for students in full-time school or college (Year 10 and above) is applied for through the British Airways careers website after registering on its student platform. The listing checked was for the 2025 cycle, so check whether a current cycle is open.

name: Heathrow Airport
summary: Operator of Heathrow Airport running a Level 3 Engineering Apprenticeship that trains electromechanical technicians on airfield, baggage, terminal, energy, water and rail systems.
how_to_apply: Apply for the Engineering Apprenticeship through the Heathrow careers early-careers pages. Applications for 2026 have closed and reopen in February 2027.
